ladder.kicker: What UC Irvine actually cares about
ladder.title: 7 things are top-tier, and work experience is one of them.
ladder.lede: Your classes and GPA are mostly set by senior fall. The other top-tier rows aren't. Your essays, which UC calls Personal Insight Questions (PIQs), are where your activities, job and volunteering get explained.
considered: First in your family to go to college
not_considered: How often you toured or emailed
ladder.note: Top tier = where your hours go before Nov 30 ↓
ladder.src: Section C7, first-year admission factors, 2025–26 Common Data Set.

numbers.lede: Type your UC GPA (the weighted one UC calculates) to see where it sits next to UCI's admitted first-years. This is a range, not a cutoff.

gpa.default: The middle admitted first-year had a 4.19 weighted GPA.
gpa.near: Right around UCI's middle. Now the rest of the top tier decides it: your PIQs, activities, work and volunteering.
gpa.above: Above UCI's middle. Good start. UCI has 7 top-tier rows, so your PIQs and activities still do heavy lifting.
gpa.below: Below UCI's middle. That's not a no. UCI rates activities, work and volunteering as high as GPA. Show them in your PIQs.

todo.title: 4 moves, all aimed at UCI's top tier.

items.title: Put your job on the application.
items.body: Babysitting, a register, the family business. Work experience is top-tier at UC Irvine. List the hours a week.

items.title: Read your 4 PIQs in one sitting.
items.body: PIQs are top-tier here. If two tell the same story, swap one for a side of you the reader hasn't met yet.

items.title: Check your courses against your transcript.
items.body: The UC application has you type in every class and grade yourself. Match it line by line. Your classes and GPA are top-tier.

items.title: Add an alternate major you'd actually take.
items.body: UCI says students with a valid alternate major may be offered that major if their first choice is full. Computer science, engineering, biology and nursing are high-demand.

todo.done: All 4 done. That's a real application. ✓

title.s: Are your PIQs doing their job?
title.p: Are your student's PIQs doing their job?

lede.s: PIQs are top-tier at UC Irvine. Here's what I looked for as an admissions reader. Read all 4 of your PIQs together, then tap what's true.
lede.p: PIQs are top-tier at UC Irvine. Here's what I looked for as an admissions reader. Read all 4 of your student's PIQs together, then tap what's true.

items.title: Each one answers the exact question asked.
items.body: Circle the key words in the question. Every paragraph should answer them, not a question close to them.

items.title: Only you could have written it.
items.body: Swap in a friend's name. If it still works, it isn't specific enough yet.

items.title: It shows what you did.
items.body: Your role, your steps, what changed. Not just what the team or club did.

items.title: The 4 show 4 different sides of you.
items.body: If two PIQs tell the same story, swap one for a side of you the reader hasn't met yet.

after.s: Not sure you can check all four? That's normal. It's hard to judge your own writing.
after.p: Not sure? That's normal. It's hard to judge writing you're close to.

self_check.all_done: All 4. Nice work. A fresh reader can still catch what you can't see.

take.heading: What I saw as an admissions reader
take.quote: A job counts here. UC Irvine rates work and volunteering as high as your GPA. If you work a shift every weekend, that's not a gap in your activities. That's a PIQ. Tell the reader what you learned doing it.
